posts.title: Poetry: discourse.cpp
posts.description: This book was an early experiment in writing poetry using the technique of distributional semantics. It is fundamentally about things people say about things. And it was written by a computer (somewhat). The printed book was published by Peer Press, 2011. You can access a pdf version here.

posts.title: Poetry: Walking along oneself
posts.description: In the course of our monthly show on tech and philosopy, our tiny chatbot Botchen regularly ends up 'dreaming'. To train its dreaming module, I write short pieces of poetry that encourage less factual and dialogical patterns in the output. Here is an example of such a piece.

posts.title: Fiction: Nowhood is your time
posts.description: It had all started when The Authorities had been elected. What a joke, she had thought. Everybody was laughing about it and calling it a protest vote. No worries, no chance they would last. I mean, come on! A party who promises to replace the Moon with a hydrogen balloon!
